goal: Analytics event review: which events are tracked, what they carry, and whether they can identify a person.
use: Analytics event review: which events are tracked, what they carry, and whether they can identify a person. Use when a feature adds or changes analytics events.

steps.note: List the events. Each name, when it fires and the properties it sends.
Flag identifiers. User names, emails or open text sent as properties.
Check the purpose. Each event has a use that someone named.
Check the consent. Events that need consent are gated by it.
Report. Each event with its properties, the identifiers found and the change.
